meta.tracker_asof: Tracker figures are from Jacob's Havoc Player Milestones sheet, Last Updated APR 4, 2026 (#Game 289). SPHL regular season ended Apr 5, 2026, so late-season games may be missing from tracker-sourced totals.
meta._readme: STRUCTURE: seasons[] = frozen career history through 2025-26 (never edit in-season). baseline_pro / baseline_havoc = career totals entering 2026-27 (pre-computed, trust these). current_season = 2026-27 live counters — the ONLY thing edited on game nights. Site must display: career = baseline + current_season (pro career adds current_season since SPHL is pro; Havoc career adds current_season since all 2026-27 games are Havoc games). Milestone flags computed off those live sums. After the season, fold current_season into seasons[] as a new row, recompute baselines, zero the counters for 2027-28.

players.name: Connor Fries
players.notes: Complete career data from EliteProspects (provided by Jacob, Aug 2026) — totals now computed directly from season rows and match the Apr 2026 tracker on GP/G/A/PTS (329 GP, 86-107-193 pro; 106 GP, 23-35-58, 198 PIM w/ Havoc). Verified vs SPHL official stats (306 GP, 74-93-167, 485 PIM SPHL career; 14 GP playoff career). SPHL seasons include shots/PPG/GWG/SHG from league stats.
